reporter.title: TraceMem: Weaving Narrative Memory Schemata from User Conversational Traces

rows.notes: LoCoMo, 10 conversations, 1,540 questions in four categories (adversarial excluded, §4.1.1). Accuracy judged CORRECT/WRONG by GPT-4o-mini with the judge prompt the paper attributes to Nemori (App. A), same prompt for all methods (§4.1.3). Category names as in the paper; Open-domain has 96 questions (0.7083 = 68/96), i.e. LoCoMo category id 3, and Multi-hop 282 (category id 1). Baseline evaluated in the paper under the same judge prompt; the paper does not describe how it was run (memory model assumed to be the stated backbone, embedding not stated). Full context: whole dialogue given to the LLM.
